key.name: github-token
key.description: Legacy plaintext token retained only for migration to Secret Service. New credentials must never be written to this key.

key.name: legacy-token-host
key.summary: API host associated with the legacy token
key.description: Internal non-secret marker preventing a legacy plaintext token from being sent to a different API host.

key.name: token-generation
key.description: Internal non-secret counter used to refresh credentials after a token change.

key.name: github-host
key.description: Host for API, e.g. api.github.com or github.example.com for Enterprise (uses /api/v3).

key.name: watched-repos
key.description: Repos to poll for new issues, new pull requests and new stars, e.g. "gnome/gnome-shell,torvalds/linux"

key.name: muted-repos
key.description: Repositories excluded from issue and star polling, inbox display, badges, and desktop notification banners. Muting does not mark GitHub notifications as read.

key.name: quiet-hours-enabled
key.description: Suppress desktop alerts during the configured local-time window.

key.name: quiet-hours-start
key.description: Local 24-hour clock time in HH:MM format.

key.name: quiet-hours-end
key.description: Local 24-hour clock time in HH:MM format; the end is exclusive.

key.name: pause-polling-during-quiet-hours
key.description: When false, inbox data and the badge continue updating silently.

key.name: poll-interval
key.description: How often to poll GitHub (60–3600 seconds).

key.name: watch-mentions
key.summary: Poll /notifications for mentions and review requests

key.name: watch-issues-prs
key.summary: Poll watched repos for new issues and PRs

key.name: watch-stars
key.summary: Poll watched repos for new stars

key.name: filter-reviews
key.summary: Show review requests and review-related notifications

key.name: show-daily-stats
key.description: Store local daily counts for newly observed notifications and repository activity; disabled by default.

key.name: mark-read-on-open
key.summary: Mark notifications as read when opened
key.description: Automatically mark GitHub notifications as read after opening their link.

key.name: hide-when-empty
key.summary: Hide the panel icon when there is nothing unread

key.name: notification-summary
key.description: Versioned JSON snapshot of visible notification/activity counts for companion integrations. Never contains credentials or item details.

key.name: last-state
key.summary: Internal JSON blob tracking last-seen ids/counts

key.name: icon-always-unlit
key.description: Leave the Octocat dim even when notifications are waiting.
